description: Election Commission - Declare that P. S. K. Peiris was elected as the member of the No. 04 Kalubowila of Dehiwala, Mt. Lavinia M/C
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Dehiwala-Mt. Lavinia Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new elected member to replace one who ceased to be a member of their party. This content falls directly under electoral processes and the administration of local government elections, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette.
